helpText: This is the image that will be shown in the Reward Shop Grid. The dimensions should be kept as 112 width x 168 height or larger in that aspect ratio.
If this is selected, by clicking on this offer, we will send it to sweepstakes purchase flow.
If this is selected, to acquire this offer, players will have to acquire all other non-locked offers before enabling this one to be purchasable.
If this is selected, when the player navigates to the Event Shop, this offer will be previewed by default. Please ensure only one featured offer is running at a time.
